description: Scale and clean with generalised moderate periodontitis. Checks that pocket depths and bleeding on probing survive into the note, and that a six-week review is captured rather than a routine recall.

transcript.text: You mentioned bleeding when you brush?
Yes, most mornings. My gums feel tender.
Medical history: type 2 diabetes, metformin, well controlled. Non-smoker.
BPE 3 3 2. Probing depths 4 to 5 millimetres upper right and lower left, bleeding on probing throughout. Moderate calculus lower anterior. Generalised marginal inflammation.
I'll do a full scale and clean today, ultrasonic plus hand scaling, then fluoride.
Six weeks for a review, and I want you flossing with the interdental brushes I showed you.

fields.chiefComplaint: Reports bleeding gums on brushing most mornings, with generalised tenderness.
fields.history: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, managed with metformin, reported as well controlled. Non-smoker. No known allergies.
fields.toothFindings: Moderate calculus on the lower anterior teeth. No caries visible on examination of the dentition present.
fields.findingsGingival: BPE 3 3 2. Probing depths of 4–5 mm upper right and lower left quadrants with bleeding on probing throughout. Generalised marginal inflammation with moderate subgingival calculus.
fields.diagnosis: Generalised moderate chronic periodontitis with marginal gingivitis, complicated by diabetes as a risk modifier.
fields.treatmentPerformed: Full mouth supragingival and subgingival scale and clean performed with ultrasonic and hand instruments. Fluoride varnish applied. Oral hygiene instruction given.
fields.recommendations: Interdental brushing daily in addition to twice-daily manual brushing. Continue diabetes management with the usual GP reviews.
fields.recallRequirements: Periodontal review in six weeks to re-measure probing depths and reinforce oral hygiene.

recorded.patientSummary: We cleaned your teeth above and below the gum line today and applied fluoride. Your gums are inflamed and there is some bone-level loss to monitor. Please use the interdental brushes daily and return in six weeks for a re-check.
